sql: SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(st.id) AS numero_lojas FROM brands b LEFT JOIN stores st ON st.brand_id = b.id GROUP BY b.name
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-01-01'
SELECT st.name AS loja, COUNT(e.id) AS funcionarios FROM employees e JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id GROUP BY st.name
SELECT s.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, COUNT(s.id) AS numero_taloes FROM sales s GROUP BY s.payment_method ORDER BY numero_taloes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT st.name AS loja, COUNT(s.id) AS numero_vendas FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY numero_vendas DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS ticket_medio FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE b.name ILIKE 'Café Aroma'
SELECT p.name AS produto, m.margin_pct AS margem_pct FROM product_margins m JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id ORDER BY m.margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS compras_por_receber FROM purchases p WHERE p.status = 'encomendada'
SELECT COUNT(t.id) AS numero_transferencias FROM transfers t WHERE t.transfer_date >= '2026-01-01' AND t.transfer_date < '2027-01-01'
SELECT i.name AS ingrediente, i.unit_cost AS custo_por_unidade FROM ingredients i ORDER BY i.unit_cost DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 2) AS horas FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'BurgerLab Maia' AND sh.shift_date >= '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < '2026-11-01'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.payment_method = 'mbway' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.total) * 100, 2) AS percentagem_mbway FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s2.total), 2) - ROUND(SUM(s1.total), 2) AS diferenca_faturacao FROM sales s1 JOIN stores st ON st.id = s1.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s1.sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND s1.sold_at < '2026-10-01' UNION ALL SELECT ROUND(SUM(s2.total), 2) - ROUND(SUM(s1.total), 2) AS diferenca_faturacao FROM sales s1 JOIN stores st ON st.id = s1.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s1.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s1.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(sl.quantity + mi.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id JOIN sale_lines mi ON mi.product_id = p.id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE p.name ILIKE 'Pastéis de nata' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity), 3) AS quantidade, i.unit AS unidade FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = sk.store_id WHERE i.name ILIKE 'Leite' GROUP BY i.unit

SELECT w.name AS armazem, ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity), 3) AS quantidade, i.unit AS unidade FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = sk.warehouse_id WHERE i.name ILIKE 'Café em grão' GROUP BY w.name, i.unit

SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(t.id) AS numero_transferencias FROM stores st JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id JOIN transfers t ON t.store_id = st.id WHERE t.transfer_date >= '2026-01-01' AND t.transfer_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.price), 2) AS valor_total FROM purchases p WHERE p.status = 'recebida' AND p.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND p.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT p.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS talao_medio FROM sales s JOIN payment_methods p ON p.id = s.payment_method WHERE s.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY talao_medio DESC
SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(e.id) AS funcionarios FROM employees e JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id GROUP BY b.name
SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.hourly_rate), 2) AS custo_horario_medio FROM employees e WHERE e.role ILIKE 'barista'

SELECT date_trunc('month', s.sold_at)::date AS mes, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'BurgerLab Maia' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

SELECT st.name AS loja, MAX(s.sold_at) AS ultima_venda FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'Café Aroma Porto' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY st.name

SELECT ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-10-01' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END)) - 1) * 100, 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM sales s

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name

SELECT b.name AS marca, st.name AS loja, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name, st.name ORDER BY b.name, faturacao DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sl.quantity * (sl.unit_price - pm.unit_cost)) + SUM(sm.quantity * (sm.unit_price - mm.unit_cost)), 2) AS margem_total FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.product_id = p.id JOIN sale_lines sm ON sm.menu_id IS NOT NULL JOIN menu_margins mm ON mm.menu_id = sm.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(pm.unit_margin + mm.unit_margin), 2) AS margem_total FROM product_margins pm JOIN brands b ON b.id = pm.brand_id LEFT JOIN menu_margins mm ON mm.brand_id = b.id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY margem_total DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(pr.product_id) AS produtos_cao FROM price_recommendations pr JOIN brands b ON b.id = pr.brand_id WHERE pr.classification = 'cão' GROUP BY b.name
SELECT p.name AS produto, b.name AS marca FROM price_recommendations pr JOIN products p ON p.id = pr.product_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = pr.brand_id WHERE pr.classification = 'estrela'

SELECT st.name AS loja, ROUND(((SUM(s2.total) - SUM(s1.total)) / SUM(s1.total)) * 100, 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM sales s1 JOIN stores st ON st.id = s1.store_id JOIN sales s2 ON s2.store_id = st.id WHERE s1.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s1.sold_at < '2025-11-01' AND s2.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s2.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY crescimento_percentual DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(e.hourly_rate * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 2) AS custo_funcionarios FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE sh.shift_date >= '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.name

SELECT b.name AS marca, p.name AS produto, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name, p.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC
